# Outdoor Life

> > America's premier outdoor magazine covering hunting, fishing, conservation policy, survival skills, and wild game cooking since 1898.

Outdoor Life provides expert guidance on hunting techniques, fishing strategies, firearms reviews, wilderness survival, and wild game recipes. The publication also covers critical conservation policy issues, public lands management, and interviews with key figures like Interior Secretary Ryan Zinke and political leaders affecting outdoor recreation.

## Key Topics

- Public lands management
- Conservation policy
- Whitetail deer hunting
- Wild game recipes
- Survival skills and wilderness survival
- Interior Secretary and federal policy
- Hunting dogs and techniques
- Fishing strategies
- Firearms and optics reviews
- Game bird preparation
- Mountain hunting
- Scent lures and hunting tactics
- Cast iron cooking
- DIY hunting adventures

## Conservation and Public Lands Policy

- [Zinke's World View](https://www.outdoorlife.com/zinkes-world-view): Interior Secretary Ryan Zinke interview on public lands and conservation
- [An Open Letter to Secretary Zinke](https://www.outdoorlife.com/an-open-letter-to-secretary-zinke): Editorial defending national monuments under Antiquities Act review
- [Is the Trump Administration Really Looking Out for Outdoorsmen and Women? That Might Be Up to Interior Secretary David Bernhardt](https://www.outdoorlife.com/is-trump-administration-really-looking-out-for-outdoorsmen-and-women-that-might-be-up-to-interior): Analysis of Interior Secretary David Bernhardt's public lands policies
- [Hillary Clinton on Public Lands, Conservation, and Funding Wildlife Agencies](https://www.outdoorlife.com/hillary-clinton-on-conservation-public-lands-and): Hillary Clinton's 2016 conservation and public lands policy positions
- [How Donald Trump's Sons Became Hunters](https://www.outdoorlife.com/how-donald-trumps-sons-became-hunters-and-what-their-outdoor-experiences-have-taught-donald): Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump on hunting heritage and conservation policy

## Hunting Guides and Techniques

- [Catch A Cougar The best strategies for hunting America's big cats](https://www.outdoorlife.com/catch-cougar-best-strategies-for-hunting-americas-big-cats): Mountain lion hunting strategies using hounds and tracking techniques
- [Spot and Stalk Hunting the Goats of Kodiak Island](https://www.outdoorlife.com/spot-and-stalk-hunting-goats-kodiak-island): DIY mountain goat hunt on Alaska's Kodiak Island with brown bears
- [Do Deer Urine Lures Actually Work?](https://www.outdoorlife.com/do-deer-urine-lures-actually-work): Analysis of deer urine scent lure effectiveness for whitetail hunting
- [Are Hunting Dogs Better When Kept Indoors or Outdoors?](https://www.outdoorlife.com/are-hunting-dogs-better-kept-indoors-or-outdoors): Debunking myths about indoor vs outdoor hunting dogs with expert advice

## Firearms and Optics

- [5 Fixed Focus Hunting Scopes, and Why You Should Consider Using One](https://www.outdoorlife.com/5-fixed-focus-hunting-scopes-and-why-you-should-consider-using-one): Fixed power riflescope comparison and benefits for hunting applications
- [Takedown Rifles These new guns are a traveling hunter's dream](https://www.outdoorlife.com/takedown-rifles-these-new-guns-are-traveling-hunters-dream): Takedown rifle options from Marlin, Savage, Winchester for travel hunters
- [Training Drills to Become a Better Long-Range Shooter](https://www.outdoorlife.com/at-home-precision-rifle-hunting-drills): Scott Satterlee's home dry-fire drills for PRS precision rifle training
- [Shotgun Review: The Benelli Ethos](https://www.outdoorlife.com/blogs/gun-shots/shotgun-review-benelli-ethos): Benelli Ethos 12-gauge inertia shotgun review for hunting applications

## Wild Game Recipes and Cooking

- [Cooking with Crow Meat: A Recipe for "Blackbird" Pie](https://www.outdoorlife.com/blogs/cast-iron-chef/cooking-crow-meat-recipe-blackbird-pie): Wild crow meat recipe: Alex Robinson's brined crow breasts in pot pie
- [A Quick Recipe for Smoked Ruffed Grouse Breast](https://www.outdoorlife.com/blogs/cast-iron-chef/quick-recipe-smoked-ruffed-grouse-breast): Bradley smoker recipe for cured and smoked ruffed grouse breast

## Survival Skills and Wilderness Techniques

- [Survival Skills: 5 Attributes You Need for a Survivor's Mindset](https://www.outdoorlife.com/blogs/survivalist/survival-skills-5-attributes-you-need-survivors-mindset): Mental traits and psychology for developing a survivor's mindset
- [How to Identify and Use the Common Mullein for Natural Uses and Survival Situations](https://www.outdoorlife.com/blogs/survivalist/how-identify-and-use-common-mullein-natural-uses-and-survival-situations): Verbascum thapsus identification and survival uses for mullein plant
- [How to Rig a Paiute Deadfall Trap, Step by Step](https://www.outdoorlife.com/how-to-rig-paiute-deadfall-trap-step-by-step): Step-by-step guide to building Paiute Indian deadfall rodent trap

## Fishing Guides

- [Wipers: Catching Hybrid Striped Bass](https://www.outdoorlife.com/wipers-catching-hybrid-striped-bass): Guide to catching hybrid striped bass at Cumberland River and TN lakes

## Optional

- [My Friend Charlie Alsheimer: 1947-2017](https://www.outdoorlife.com/my-friend-charlie-alsheimer-memorial-1947-2017): Memorial tribute to deer photographer and writer Charlie Alsheimer
